resources.string: Scan another device to join the Mesh

"Or, enter the connect URI below:
" "1. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled
" "2. Allow everyone to share data via Quick Share
" "3. After getting the URI, click copy
" "4. Paste the URI into the text field below
" "5. Click "Connect via Entering Connect URI""

"To share the connect URI:
" "1. Make sure Bluetooth is enabled on this device
" "2. Click "Share connect URI"
" "3. Select Quick Share
" "4. Choose a nearby device you want to share the URI with"
Stay connected — even without Wi-Fi or signal.
Project Mesh lets nearby phones talk to each other directly, like a walkie-talkie for your phone — no internet needed.
Your phone may also help pass along messages for nearby devices.
This keeps everyone connected. It uses a small amount of battery and data.
